limits: All fixtures are synthetic local applications and offline pricing/calibration; no actual target model ability or live provider prices measured.
Independent challenge count is 22 curated contracts, not independent production traffic; no statistical population improvement claim.
All current repairs and added regression variants are validation after observed failures, not untouched holdout.
Old missing extensions remain unsupported rather than whole-skill quality failures.
Stage coverage challenge checks a predeclared cardinality, not independent proof of every member identity.
Process runner does not enforce filesystem/network/credential isolation; hashes are not adversarial authentication.
